title: Atomic DIO policy transaction does not wait and revalidate generation leases
description: LinkLayer.transact_authenticated_schc_dio holds the security lock but does not wait for foreign generation leases. Existing elevate_authenticated_dio/elevate_time_generation callbacks run outside that lock while holding a generation lease, so a rival same-generation DIO transaction can replace policy and commit routing concurrently. Wait for foreign leases, then revalidate issuance, pin/generation, counter, and prior policy after the condition wait before prepare/install; add a blocking lease regression.
